name: 37411 · Chattanooga, TN
findings: ZIP 37411 (Chattanooga) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37411 (Chattanooga) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37411 (Chattanooga) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
